caption_judgement: All three captions are substantive rather than restatements of the panel titles: each names the machine or analytic case, the grey/blue series mapping, the shared physical levels, the wall and null vocabulary, and the generating and recovered public-forward residuals with their converged flags, and each records which job rendered the panel. No caption finding is recorded.

figures.identification: The attachment order is not recorded, so each PNG was identified from what it renders. image-0 draws a single closed D-shaped first wall with a lower divertor notch and a smooth outboard boundary, the ITER reference wall shape; it is one of the two generating/recovered pairs and not the analytic ellipse, so it is iter.svg.

image-1 draws a stepped rectangular first wall with port cut-outs on the inboard and outboard sides, the MAST 22086/43 vessel outline taken by the run's MAST case; it is the second of the two machine pairs, so it is mast.svg.
image-2 is the analytic pair: an elliptic wall and concentric closed contours with a single axis marker in each panel and no X-point, exactly the Solov'ev state the caption describes.

0.reason: Non-blocking: the recovered and generating nulls coincide to 1e-12 of the flux span, so the overdrawn marker misreads no datum and the caption states both sets are drawn. The section 2 comparison panels, where the two codes' nulls differ, are briefed to draw the two null sets in distinct hollow and filled styles.

1.reason: Non-blocking: the legend swatches follow the house legend weight while contours are drawn thin to stay separable at twelve levels; colour, not stroke weight, identifies the series. The section 2 panels are briefed to match legend and contour weight.

findings.summary: In every generating/recovered pair (image-0 iter, image-1 mast, image-2 solovev) the loop draws the generating null markers first and the recovered markers second at the same coordinates with the blue style on top, so the generating (left) panel shows a blue recovered-coloured axis triangle and X marker; the grey generating marker survives only as a thin rim, measured as a 1-2 px grey outline around the blue triangle and cross in each PNG. The legend assigns blue to the recovered series, so a reader looking at the generating panel sees a recovered-coloured null on the generating state. The caption says both sets are drawn and coincide, and no datum is misread, but the 'both null sets' encoding is much weaker than the caption claims and the rim may vanish when the 31.1 cm canvas is served into the page's narrower column.

The legend swatches are constructed at line widths 2.6 pt and 3.0 pt while the contours they identify are drawn at 1.2 pt (draw_scattered_contours, line 1047). In the rendered PNG the legend marks occupy about five pixel rows against about two for the contour lines, so the key carries more than twice the stroke weight of the data it names, which over-weights the legend relative to the field and misstates the series' line weight to a reader who compares them.
